app.name: Uptime
app.description: A minimal, self-hosted uptime monitor with editable dashboards.

auth.signInDescription: Only the admin account can create or change monitors and dashboards. Everything else is public.

empty.title: No monitors yet
empty.description: Add the first monitor to start collecting uptime data.
empty.readonly: The admin has not added any monitors yet.

type.httpDescription: Requests a URL and checks the status code, an optional keyword and the TLS certificate.
type.pingDescription: Sends ICMP echo requests to a host and measures the round trip time.

fields.name: Name
fields.keywordInverted: Fail when the keyword is present
fields.certificateExpiryWarningDays: Warn this many days before expiry

hints.expectedStatusCodes: Single codes and ranges, separated by commas. For example 200-299,301.
hints.keyword: The response body must contain this text for the check to pass.
hints.retries: Failures tolerated before the monitor is reported as down.
hints.timeout: Seconds a single check may take.
hints.ignoreTls: Accepts self signed and expired certificates. Only use this for internal hosts.
hints.active: Paused monitors keep their history but are not checked.

delete.title: Delete monitor
delete.description: "{name}" and its entire history will be removed. Widgets referencing it are deleted as well. This cannot be undone.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.editModeHint: Drag widgets to move them and pull the bottom right corner to resize. Changes are saved automatically.

hints.slug: Used in the address bar, for example /d/production.
hints.isDefault: Visitors landing on the start page are sent to this dashboard.

empty.title: This dashboard is empty
empty.description: Switch to edit mode and add your first widget.
empty.readonly: The admin has not added any widgets to this dashboard yet.

delete.title: Delete dashboard
delete.description: "{name}" and all of its widgets will be removed. The monitors themselves stay untouched.

dashboard.lastDashboard: The last dashboard cannot be deleted.

widget.monitorMissing: The referenced monitor no longer exists.

typeDescription.monitor: Status, response time and the recent pulse of one monitor.
typeDescription.uptime-summary: A single large uptime percentage for one monitor.
typeDescription.latency-chart: Response time over a selectable time range.
typeDescription.status-overview: Counts of all monitors by status.
typeDescription.heading: A text label to group widgets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountDescription: Change the credentials of the single admin account.
settings.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. At least 10 characters.

error.unauthorized: Please sign in as admin to do that.

validation.url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL
validation.hostname: Enter a valid hostname or IP address
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only
validation.statusCodes: Use single codes or ranges, for example 200-299,301
validation.timeoutTooLong: The timeout must not exceed the check interval
validation.monitorRequired: Select a monitor for this widget
